The FloPlast push-fit access branch is a robust uPVC plumbing component for soil and vent systems, designed to provide essential access for inspection and maintenance. This 110mm double socket branch, with its 92.5° angle, is ideal for connecting additional waste pipes within drainage installations. Manufactured from lightweight uPVC, it offers strength and long-term durability, ensuring reliability for high temperature waste discharges. The push-fit connection with ring seal joints allows for quick and secure installation, facilitating efficient work on site. It features two 67mm boss inlets, enabling connection of 32 and 40mm boss adaptors, simplifying complex drainage layouts.The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
